title: Control Plane / Routing bugsprint huddle — 2026-08-29
content:
Meeting: Control Plane — Routing/Quotas bugsprint huddle
Date: 2026-08-29 09:30 PT (30m)
Location: Zoom / #platform-routing Slack follow-up thread
Facilitator: Asha Kapoor

Attendees:
- Asha Kapoor (owner)
- Ben Chen
- Marta Ivanova
- Luis Martinez
- Ethan Park (oncall)
- Riley O'Neill (observability)

Quick context (1–2 lines):
We paused feature work for a focused bugsprint after last week's incidents: routing mismatches under burst load and quota accounting drift. Goal this week is to triage top 6 bugs, deploy fixes behind feature flags, and validate via bench + smoke on Dedicated staging.

Highlights from today's huddle:
1) Routing mismatch under 1k rps bursts (PLT-4821)
- Ben summarized repro steps: heavy concurrent golden-path requests using model variants + long prefix tokens. Root cause narrowed to stale routing cache entries when node pool scales down quickly.
- Short-term mitigation: reduce scale-down aggressiveness on staging pools and enable prefix cache eviction TTL = 10s.
- Long-term: implement versioned routing cache keys and add a cache-invalidation hook in the autoscaler.
- Owner for quick mitigation: Ben — deploy change to staging by 2026-08-30.

2) Quota accounting drift for batch requests (PLT-4793)
- Marta showed traces where batched requests were double-counted when retries triggered at the proxy layer.
- Immediate fix: idempotency token propagation (proxy -> router -> quota service) to deduplicate billing events.
- Temporary alert: raise quota-scrub job frequency to daily for affected customer cohorts.
- Owner: Marta + Luis (integration) — idempotency PR target 2026-09-02.

3) Auth token expiry edge-case causing 401s on long-poll streaming
- Observed in Dedicated staging for sessions > 5m. Token refresh path not invoked if streaming connection held without explicit ping.
- Fix approach: client-library heartbeat (recommended) + server-side graceful refresh when token near-expiry.
- Owner: Ethan (client-library) + Asha (server change) — spike/POC 2026-09-01.

4) Quotas UI shows stale usage after fast rollouts
- Riley: dashboards rely on eventual indices; introduce cached snapshot endpoint for Console to fetch near-real-time counters during rollouts.
- Short-term dashboard note explaining eventual consistency.

Operational notes / short-term runbook additions:
- Add a small entry to the controlplane runbook: "routing-cache-scale-down" with the mitigation steps and the TTL knob (Asha, done 2026-08-29).
- Oncall play: if routing mismatches recur, scale-up routing pool to previous size and open an incident with tag routing-burst. (Ethan)

Metrics & validation plan:
- Ben will run the burst workload harness (internal perf job: controlplane/burst-bench v3) against staging with the TTL change and share latency/95/99 and mismatch counts by EOD 2026-08-30.
- Marta will run quota-sim test suite (quota/sim-runner) to validate dedupe in retry scenarios by 2026-09-01.

Decisions made:
- Do not roll back autoscaler changes globally; apply conservative scale-down in staging and canary to validate (decision: conservative canary).
- Prioritize idempotency propagation for quota correctness before deeper quota-service refactor.

Blockers / open questions:
- Autoscaler interacts with K8s node-provisioner plugin; need infra approval for changing scale-down TTL in prod. Who owns approval? (Action: Asha to ping infra leads, due 2026-08-30).
- Need a test harness for long-poll streaming token refresh (Ethan to prototype).

Action items (owner — due date):
- Ben: deploy routing-cache TTL = 10s to staging and run burst-bench, share results (2026-08-30).
- Marta: implement idempotency token propagation in proxy layer, open PR (2026-09-02).
- Luis: wire proxy headers through quota ingestion pipeline and add dedupe logic (2026-09-02).
- Ethan: prototype client-library heartbeat + server refresh POC (2026-09-01).
- Asha: request infra sign-off for temporary scale-down change and update runbook (2026-08-30).
- Riley: add dashboard note about eventual consistency and prototype snapshot endpoint spec (2026-09-03).

Follow-ups / next meeting:
- Daily 09:30 PT quick sync for the rest of the bugsprint (15m) until 2026-09-03 or until top issues closed.
- Retrospective scheduled Friday 2026-09-03 10:00 to capture learnings and decide longer-term RCs.

Notes / stray ideas captured:
- Consider adding routing cache entry TTL knob exposed as a per-customer setting for very bursty customers.
- Explore moving quota dedup into a lightweight kafkA dedupe topic keyed by idempotency token.

Quick links referenced during huddle:
- PLT-4821 (routing cache repro)
- PLT-4793 (quota double-count)
- PR: controlplane#812 (attempted fix for cache invalidation)
- Slack thread: #platform-routing-thread (linked above)

End notes: rough draft of runbook update appended to this doc (TODO: convert into canonical runbook entry in Confluence and link).
